observed_failure_before_design.mechanism_failure: The controller query compiler retained only capitalized spans, so lower-case titles and connector-rich or numeric names were truncated. Independently supported first-hop tuples consequently had no base-bound endpoint, output_slot_coverage zero, no COMMIT, and no downstream allocation.

gold_free_offline_audit.selection_rule: Query certificates changed only when a tuple endpoint is literally present in the subgoal text; no answers or gold support were inspected.

architectural_delta.query_mentioned_endpoint_binding: Before reachability, bind a candidate endpoint only when its normalized phrase or all non-generic informative tokens occur in the current subgoal text.
architectural_delta.separation_of_channels: Literal query binding affects only the controller alignment certificate; independent evidence grounding, entailment, type, contradiction, support, relative weight, entropy, and evidence gap are unchanged.

execution_order: regression canary 5 if the causal transition gate passes
independent Smoke-A20 if both canaries pass
paired control/HARA Shadow-C20 only if Smoke-A passes
stop_condition: Continue generic no-training diagnosis and iteration after failure. Stop only on the full preregistered HARA gate plus committed safe-stop report, or before the next call would exceed the shared 2000-attempt/2000000-token hard cap.
